answer: Joining requires a 40-token bond in the harbor, the protocol's escrow contract, bound to the new key and never reusable by another identity. That bond and any rewards vest over 2 epochs per newcomer already in the network-wide cohort, fixed at join, so floods never stretch earlier honest locks. A farm's 25th clone freezes its 40 tokens for 48 epochs. Ledger rules enforce this, a fraud proof burns the unvested ember, and each extra fake leaves more farm capital out on a ledge.
